title: Stalks commute with direct sums of sheaf modules
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], let $I$ be a set, and let $(\mathcal F_i)_{i\in I}$ be sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every $x\in X$, the canonical $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-linear map from the stalk of the coproduct to the coproduct of the stalks is an isomorphism $$(\bigoplus_{i\in I}\mathcal F_i)_x\;\xrightarrow{\sim}\;\bigoplus_{i\in I}(\mathcal F_i)_x,$$ where the coproducts are taken in the category of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules and of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules, respectively.

source.place: Section 009E (section-limits-sheaves), item (5), stalks commute with colimits; applied to the coproduct diagram

proof.text: *The coproduct as a sheafified presheaf direct sum.* Let $\mathcal P$ be the presheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules with $\mathcal P(U)=\bigoplus_{i\in I}\mathcal F_i(U)$, the direct sum of $\mathcal O_X(U)$-modules (families $(s_i)_i$, $s_i\in\mathcal F_i(U)$, with $s_i=0$ for all but finitely many $i$), restriction maps $(s_i)_i\mapsto(s_i|_V)_i$, and inclusions $\mathrm{in}_j:\mathcal F_j\to\mathcal P$. By [lem-weil-pbc-presheaf-modules-colimits-sectionwise] (for the discrete diagram on $I$) $(\mathcal P,(\mathrm{in}_j)_j)$ is a coproduct of the $\mathcal F_i$ in presheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules. Let $\theta:\mathcal P\to\mathcal P^\#$ be its sheafification as a presheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] on the site of open subsets of $X$. By [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful] (2), $\mathcal P^\#$ with the maps $\iota_j=\theta\circ\mathrm{in}_j$ is a coproduct of the $\mathcal F_i$ in $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]; since coproducts are unique up to unique isomorphism compatible with the injections, we may take $\bigoplus_i\mathcal F_i=\mathcal P^\#$ with injections $\iota_j$. Infinite $I$ is allowed: only sections of $\mathcal P$, not of $\mathcal P^\#$, are finitely supported.

source.place: Section 009E (section-limits-sheaves), items (3) and (5): colimits of sheaves are sheafified presheaf colimits, and stalks commute with colimits

proof.text: *Sheafification does not change the stalk.* By [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] the underlying sheaf of abelian groups of $\mathcal P^\#$ is the abelian sheafification of $\mathcal P$, with $\theta$ as its unit, and $\theta$ is $\mathcal O_X$-linear. By [lem-weil-pbc-stalk-sheafification-space] the map $\theta_x:\mathcal P_x\to\mathcal P^\#_x$, $p_x\mapsto\theta_U(p)_x$, is an isomorphism of abelian groups. It is $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-linear: for $a=r_x$, $\xi=p_x$ with $r\in\mathcal O_X(U)$, $p\in\mathcal P(U)$ (a common neighbourhood exists since the neighbourhoods of $x$ are directed), $\theta_x(a\xi)=\theta_U(rp)_x=(r\,\theta_U(p))_x=a\,\theta_x(\xi)$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. So $\theta_x$ is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules.

source.place: Section 009E (section-limits-sheaves), items (3) and (5): colimits of sheaves are sheafified presheaf colimits, and stalks commute with colimits

proof.text: *Stalks of the presheaf direct sum (filtered colimits commute with direct sums).* Define $\psi:\mathcal P_x\to\bigoplus_i(\mathcal F_i)_x$ by $\psi(((s_i)_i)_x)=((s_i)_x)_i$ for $(s_i)_i\in\mathcal P(U)$, $x\in U$; the right side is finitely supported because $(s_i)_i$ is. It is well defined, additive and $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-linear, since restriction and multiplication by $r\in\mathcal O_X(U)$ act componentwise on $\mathcal P(U)$ and germs satisfy $(s|_W)_x=s_x$, $(rs)_x=r_xs_x$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Surjective: an element of $\bigoplus_i(\mathcal F_i)_x$ has finitely many nonzero components $(t_j)_x$, $t_j\in\mathcal F_j(U_j)$, $j\in J$ finite; on $U=\bigcap_{j\in J}U_j$ the family with components $t_j|_U$ ($j\in J$) and $0$ elsewhere lies in $\mathcal P(U)$ and its germ maps to the element. Injective: if $\psi(((s_i)_i)_x)=0$, the finitely many nonzero $s_j$ ($j\in J$) have $(s_j)_x=0$, so $s_j|_{W_j}=0$ for neighbourhoods $W_j$ of $x$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]; on $W=\bigcap_{j\in J}W_j$ the family restricts to $0$, so its germ is $0$. Hence $\psi$ is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules.

source.place: Section 009E (section-limits-sheaves), items (3) and (5): colimits of sheaves are sheafified presheaf colimits, and stalks commute with colimits

proof.text: *Conclusion.* Put $\Phi=\psi\circ\theta_x^{-1}:(\bigoplus_i\mathcal F_i)_x\to\bigoplus_i(\mathcal F_i)_x$, an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules by the two preceding steps. For $s\in\mathcal F_j(U)$, $\Phi((\iota_j)_x(s_x))=\Phi(\theta_U(\mathrm{in}_j s)_x)=\psi((\mathrm{in}_j s)_x)$, the family with $s_x$ in slot $j$ and $0$ elsewhere; so $\Phi\circ(\iota_j)_x$ is the $j$-th injection of the module coproduct, i.e. $\Phi$ is the canonical comparison map induced by the $(\iota_j)_x$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Naturality in the family: for morphisms $f_i:\mathcal F_i\to\mathcal G_i$ both $\theta_x$ and $\psi$ commute with the induced maps, by the germ formulas.

split_report.summary: Reviewer R-sds2334 rewrote the proof along Stacks 009E (3),(5): the sheaf coproduct is the sheafification of the sectionwise direct sum, sheafification does not change stalks, and the stalk of the sectionwise direct sum is the direct sum of the stalks (germ-level, finite support of presheaf sections). The unsplit local-support node was dropped.

lean.statement: theorem exists_stalk_directSum_linearEquiv {X : TopCat.{u}} (R : X.Sheaf RingCat.{u}) (I : Type u) (_hcomm : ∀ (U : Opens X) (r s : R.obj.obj (op U)), r * s = s * r) (F : I → SheafOfModules.{u} R) (x : X) : ∃ e : (stalk (C := AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (X := X) (∐ F).val.presheaf x) ≃ₗ[stalk (C := RingCat.{u}) (X := X) R.obj x] (⨁ i : I, (stalk (C := AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (X := X) (F i).val.presheaf x)), ∀ (i : I) (U : Opens X) (hx : x ∈ U) (s : (F i).val.obj (op U)), e (germ (∐ F).val.presheaf U x hx ((Sigma.ι F i).val.app (op U) s)) = DirectSum.lof (stalk (C := RingCat.{u}) (X := X) R.obj x) I (fun j : I => ↑(stalk (C := AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (X := X) (F j).val.presheaf x)) i (germ (F i).val.presheaf U x hx s)

reviewed_lean.note: ringed space = TopCat X + R : X.Sheaf RingCat with sectionwise commutativity (_hcomm, per def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism); I : Type u arbitrary, no finiteness; F : I -> SheafOfModules R; every x; coproduct ∐ F in SheafOfModules (existence from Sheaf.Colimits); stalks TopCat.Presheaf.stalk with Mathlib ModuleCat/Stalk RingCat module instance; ⨁ direct sum; ∃ linear equiv in node direction with e ∘ (ι_i)_x = lof i, so e⁻¹ is the canonical map; docstring carries the 4 proof steps; not H4: J1 lem-kun-stalks-commute-colimits is abelian sheaves on small étale site, Mathlib has only presheaf stalkFunctor adjunction/finite-limit preservation, no module-sheaf coproduct stalk statement
